benchmark_admission_rule: A candidate red family must be audited for known polynomial upper bounds in the same or stronger admitted proof system before generic cap hits are interpreted as discovery barriers. A located upper bound reclassifies the family as a positive schema control.
closure_condition: If the portfolio (or a frozen polynomial extension of it) always provides an exact accepted rank-decreasing step with total cumulative work/bytes <= N^K for one universal fixed K and terminates after polynomially many rank decreases, then SAT is in P and P=NP.
